description: WHEN: developer needs to check that a proposed object name follows D365 + ISV naming conventions, is unique against the indexed KB, and does not collide with a reserved or standard prefix. Triggers: 'is this a valid name', 'check naming', 'name conflict', 'valider le nommage'. Cloud-safe: KB read only, no writes.

aotType.description: AOT type the name will live in: AxClass, AxTable, AxForm, AxEdt, AxEnum, AxTableExtension, AxFormExtension, AxClassExtension, etc.

isvPrefix.description: ISV prefix you must use, e.g. 'ALM'. Required for all custom objects.

name: validate_object_naming
